interview.secured: The app never spelled it out, but from the screen it seems a day counts as secured once you finish your task for that day. Right now it says '0 days secured' and 'Nothing done today. 1 task left.'
interview.freeze: The app never explained what a freeze is in anything I saw, so I can't say. I'd only be guessing that it saves a streak.
interview.selfReported: It seems to mean you just check the task off yourself, with no photo or other proof. 'Do 10 pushups' says Self-reported with a 'Check off' button, while the water challenge asked for a camera proof.
interview.tomorrow: 6 - It's simple and Kim invited me, so I'd probably check in on the 7-day gym challenge. But some terms are unexplained and I haven't seen much payoff yet.

goals.text: The invite opened Kim's challenge: accept it and join. Then find Kim's proof post on the challenge or in the feed. Like it, double-tap the photo, and leave a one-line comment. Then tap Kim's name to open the profile.
